Below is Google Translate
-------------------------------------------------- ------------------------
[h2]An introduction to some details of this mod.[/h2]
1. Compatible with chests in other mods. Specifically, all items that have a container component and don't move (so Chester can't), so backpacks are also included.
____ Explain the mechanism of the backpack, because the backpack is not a building and can be moved. 1. When the backpack is placed on the ground, check the small wooden signs around once, and set the items you have collected. 2. When the backpack is picked up, turn off the collection function.
2. The special minisign has the function of reverse selection
____for example. A minisign with a Collect All Items that will collect all nearby drops. If you don't want it to collect traps, you can place a trap minisign at the same position (use architectural geometry mod to place multiple minisign into the same position).
3. Use architectural geometry to insert multiple minisigns into the same position
____ This allows a chest to collect multiple items

-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------
[h2]Some of the functions that this mod can do:[/h2]
1. Branch Tree Factory
____ Place the chest first, and place the Factory with twigs. Then plant the multi-branched tree two plots (distance 8) away from the chest, within the set collection distance.
____ This makes it possible to automatically collect twigs from multi-branched trees.
____You can also put a few super fishing tackle boxes on the twig minisign to increase the number of twig storage
____When the chest is full and you want to stop, you can place twigs with a stack number of 2 under the multi-branched tree, once every two plots. (This is the mechanism that uses multi-branched trees to generate small branches)

2. Marble Factory
____ Similar to multi-branched trees, but requires a subscription to another mod to make marble trees also drop items
____ There is no need to maintain a distance of two plots from the box. Because multi-branched trees will detect twigs in chests, and this mod implementation does not detect marble in chests.
____ Therefore, the branch tree factory and the marble factory can be combined in the same place range. Marble is planted inside, and multi-branched trees are planted outside.
____ Another mod is a collection of small functions [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2986121603]small functions[/url]

3. Fertilizer factory
____ Place crates with fertilizer signs near the herd

4. Seed Collection
____ Place the seed packet near the wooden sign that collects all items. Can automatically collect seeds generated by birds

5. Some other collection scenes
____Such as drop collection from starfish traps for pigmen and bunnymen.
____ or the collection of dropped items from the gem factory.

publishedfiledetails.title: Simple Economy
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]-- 简单经济学 --[/h1]
[h1]-- Simple Economy --[/h1]
Implemented a new shopping system, where players can now earn gold in game.
Use dedicated items to earn gold.
Click on the icon at the top left corner to open the shop interface, and use gold to buy items.
Rare items will be reshuffled every 3 days in the morning.
Prices will vary seasonally.
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/u1cbVsmLTajwvyS.png[/img]

[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/eCl9mwDObHXcsy8.jpg[/img]

Feeling hungry? Use the shop to buy fresh food.
Needing a Beefalo Hat but the Beefalos are extinct? You can purchase Beefalo Horns and Wool in store.
The Miner's Hat is out of fuel? Go buy some Glowing Berries.
Dug out all the Berry Bushes? You can now buy unlimited of those in shop!
Running low on fertilizers? Grab some rot from the store!
Waiting too long for those eggs to rot? Buy rotten eggs directly from the shop!
Want to get some nice flooring without having to dig around? Purchase them in store!
No time to craft armors while being chased by mobs? Insta-buy them!
Can't defeat Bearger before winter? Buy its fur directly.
You can also buy the Canary and summon the Misery Toadstool anytime!
Etc, etc...
As long as you've got the cash :P

How to earn gold? 
Use dedicated items: Midas Wand, Lucky Charm, and Gold Digger.
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/QJ4qhVHnBASW6Pk.gif[/img]

————————————————————————————————————
[h1]Dedicated Items[/h1]
These items can be purchased in store and provide different ways to earn cash.
They can only be bought and cannot be crafted.

[h1]Midas Wand[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/XlIjxCbkJTzGfQZ.png[/img]
The first one comes with startup and has 35 durability.
Right clicking the ground will disintegrate everything in a small range into gold.
The amount of gold dropped is 1/3 of its price. In the case for rare items, it’s 5% of the price. If an item has durability then its price varies depending on remaining durability.
Depending on your shopping level, you have up to 25% chance to insta-kill a mob with low health. The amount of gold gained depends on its max health.

[h1]Lucky Charm[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/LM7KNdtlgR8hV9p.png[/img]
500 Durability, uses the slot of clothes or necklace.
When worn, it grants chance to obtain gold while doing the following actions: walking, picking/harvesting, eating, catching mobs, fishing, and being attacked
Every time gold is earned through these actions, durability will decrease by 1.

[h1]Gold Digger[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/TvtwLa2ubUGJM9k.png[/img]
No durability, increases movement speed by 25%
Grants chance to earn gold when chopping trees or attacking mobs.
When used as a tool, it is less effective than the regular ones (takes twice the time to get the work done).

[h1]VIP Card[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2021/07/30/Sl1pO2hvBkxtsAG.png[/img]
When the VIP card is in the inventory, the player will obtain a certain rate of discount.
Higher the shopping level, higher the discount rate.
Discount rate will be displayed on the VIP card as durability %. It will also be displayed in the shop interface.

————————————————————————————————————
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Players will obtain one Midas Wand upon entering the game, which is the only way to farm for gold in the early game. Please take care of its durability until you’ve earned enough gold to buy a second one.
Midas Wand's durability depends on the inventory slot an item would take, one stack OR a single item would use up 1/35 durability.
You can purchase the Lucky Charm or the Gold Digger for different ways to obtain gold.

As long as you have enough gold, you can disregard Midas Wand's durability and use it to disintegrate useless items.
The 4 categories: food, clothes, smithcraft and resources will have fluctuating prices depending on the season, ranging from 50%~150% of the base price.
Rare items will be reshuffled every 3rd day in the morning,

items will vary from player to player. Higher the shopping level, more the items that will be listed.
The first rare item is set to be a random blueprint.
Disintegrating a rare item will only refund 10% of its price.
Green arrows indicate a discount; red arrows indicate inflation.
Crafted goods are usually sold for 150% of the sum of prices of its ingredients. Ex: 1 wooden floor = 60g, 4 logs=40g
You can take advantage of the price fluctuations: buy only at lowest price and sell/disintegrate when the prices are inflated.

[h1]Shopping level[/h1]
Shopping level will increase upon gaining or spending gold. It affects the listing of rare items and the use of special merchandise:
VIP card: When the VIP card is in the player's inventory, a higher shopping level grants a higher discount rate. Discount rate will be displayed as the VIP card's durability.
Midas Wand: With a higher shopping level, you can insta-kill mobs with higher remaining health.
Rare item list: Higher the shopping level, more the categories of rare items will be displayed (food, clothes, smithcraft, resources, treasures)

[h1]Controls[/h1]
Right click a merchandise to buy 10 at once.
Ctrl+click on the icon in the left upper corner to see in a chat message how much gold you have.
Ctrl+shift+click on the icon to see in a floating text how much gold you have.
Items bought as a ghost will drop onto the ground next to the character (Ex: Life-Giving Amulet).

Debug Console:
[spoiler]Enter in debug "GetPlayer().components.seplayerstatus:DoDeltaCoin(1000)" to obtain 1000 gold.
If Caves are not enabled, please input: ThePlayer.components.seplayerstatus:DoDeltaCoin(1000)
If Caves are enabled, please check if the word "Remote" is displayed in the chatbox before hitting enter. If not, press ctrl to make it appear.
This code will only work if you are the administrator of the server.[/spoiler]

————————————————————————————————————
Special Thank!!
Jason Brock

And thanks Virus_J

World will regrowth itself. Every entity will grow on its proper position.

[b]The regrowth list is include: [/b]
[list]

[*]spider den
[*]totally normal tree
[*]touch stone
[*]pig head
[*]bones
[*]flint and rocks
[/list]

Here is the respawn mechanism:
When mod first installs, it will calculate the amounts of these respawnable things and save it. As we playing the game, it will compare the current amounts of these things with the amounts that saved before. And if the current amount is less, the world will spawn the thing. If the current amount is more that the origin, it will stop regrowth, which makes the world maintain the same as the origin.

With the mod, your server will never flood with too many stuffs.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The 4 iconic Don't Starve: Reign of Giants bosses reimagined.
They're looking a little smaller than usual...?

[b]"Reign of Runts" is a 4 character mod that takes the classic RoG bosses: Deerclops, Bearger, Moose/Goose, and Dragonfly and turns them into Wilson-sized playable characters ripe with perks and personalities![/b]

[h1]The Runts[/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRCdfQ8f/hp-Yb-Ohi.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4754200580379729425/][b]Deerclops's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Packs an icy punch
•Has an aptitude for structure destructure
•With an increasing itch to destroy
•At home in the cold, but not the heat[/b] 

~ *Adds coldness and can freeze enemies while attacking. During Winter this becomes an AoE
~ Can destroy structures & rocks without an item equipped, hammers faster than others
~ Gets a *small amount of sanity while destroying free-hand, or with a hammer.
- Amount of sanity gained may differ depending on the size of a structure
- If you go too long without destroying a structure your sanity will start to drain, starting at *2 days. The longer without, the higher amount of sanity drained

~ *Immune to the cold and will passively get colder
- Overheats *much sooner, takes increased fire damage
~ Overheating damage is increased by *30%, Freezing damage is reduced by *80%
~ Won't lose sanity near a Deerclops, won't slip on ice

Favorite Food: Melonsicle
Voice: Viol
Birthday: February 26
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/85XJFV9j/9a-Rm-Dw-W.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/PxVpLk9X/2Aii-BUa.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/TwNLyXFc/RFok-Fku.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0WWLM34/SQd-YRDR.png[/img]
[i]"Bearger is a simple, gluttonous beast whose only goal is to feed and sleep throughout the frigid seasons."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4140563392629647860/][b]Bearger's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•"Hibearnates" in chilly weather
•Bears an angry stomp
•Has a hankering hunger for honey[/b] 

~ Using RMB, Bearger can slam the ground doing additional AoE *damage, with double damage if close
- Ground pound affects trees, *plants, and *stumps, doesn't affect structures or flying creatures
- Hunger drains *20% faster
~ Gets additional sanity from Honey foods, takes *50% less damage from bees, and will *occasionally drop a fur tuft
- Will wake up groggy from naturally sleeping

~ During Winter & Spring Bearger will go into "Hibearnation" mode
 During "Hibearnation": 
 Hunger doesn't drain 20% faster, small winter insulation, small damage absorption (*20%)
 Will occasionally yawn instead of doing a ground pound, taking hunger
 If hunger is fuller than 50% Bearger's max hp is set to 200 and winter insulation increased. Likewise, if it's below 50% it'll be set to normal

Favorite Food: Honey Ham
Voice: Bassoon
Birthday: September 1
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DZpJWKHZ/Dui-MQUS.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Ss12Xp3W/MH58QOi.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/JnYDyWvh/63NQi-Vh.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6ZrScpC/iyg-N4UO.png[/img]
[i]"It's a lovely morning in the constant, and you are a motherly moose. ...and goose."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/6597293740379607401/][b]Moose/Goose's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Can form a feisty whirlwind
•Enjoys walks on the ocean
•Has a tendency of getting wet feathers

~ *Can use RMB to Spin for a boost. Deals damage in AoE, *Includes trees & rocks
- Spin will cause grogginess after. Can't spin while groggy.
~ While attacking, has a *10% chance to unleash a loud Honk that confuses some mobs in a small radius
- *Refuses to eat Eggs and Egg-based foods

~*Aspiring Nester: Can build the "Motherly Nesting", a nest only she can place
 It provides a passive sanity gain and a *25% defense bonus for all within its AoE, but only when a Moose/Goose is in it
 Any Moose/Goose in its AoE will drain hunger quicker
 She can place a Tallbird Egg in the nest that will allow the buff to persist within its AoE if she's not near it
 Needs attending: will collapse within *7 days if proper attention isn't given (With fuel items like twigs). Can be dug up, but will collapse if durability isn't high

~ Is able to run on the ocean, but Wetness will quickly fill up as you're on it. Protective gear or fire won't stop it
- If you're over *100% Wetness you'll drown. Can't walk on water again until below 100%
- Wetness naturally fills *60% faster
~ *Increased lightning attraction, lightning heals instead of damages. When Spring ends she molts a few feathers
~ The Moose/Goose & Mosslings will be more passive

Favorite Food: Flower Salad
Voice: Harmonica
Birthday: March 6
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gjww8Tby/Yw-EVVjz.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RFp63zy7/JRZ3Mqt.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/C5ZZkQpf/t-Et-Xgs-W.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wMttLGYD/zamwtm0.png[/img]
[i]"With her draconic temperamental roots, Dragonfly finds her new situation to be that of one to surmount with riches."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4210371957563763889//][b]Dragonfly's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Has a short fuse
•And a fiery attitude
•A dragon heat barely beats
•Can enkindle life[/b]

~ Increased overheating threshold, *fire immunity
~ Can eat Ash and Charcoal. (2 HP & Hunger)

~ Max of *10 Lavae, *500 HP, requires feeding or it'll perish, can be cooked upon, *50 dmg, emits warmth and light but not wildfires
- Summoning costs 20 Health and Hunger, if Ash is in your inventory it will consume 1 but halve the penalty
- Lavae will die on being frozen, sanity loss on death, losing all Lavae causes rage

Favorite Food: Hot Dragon Chili Salad
Voice: Hurdy Gurdy
Birthday: November 30

- Lore -

Lamb is a champion from a video game called League of Legends.

Separate, but never parted, Kindred represents the twin essences of death. Lamb's bow offers a swift release from the mortal realm for those who accept their fate. Wolf hunts down those who run from their end, delivering violent finality within his crushing jaws. Even when one of them stalks a wretched creature and crosses realms right into the dark lands of Don't Starve, Lamb and Wolf remain together, and they are always Kindred... 

- Stats -

[b]Health: 250[/b]
[b]Hunger: 125[/b]
[b]Sanity: 125[/b]

- Perks -

[b][Mark of The Kindred][/b]

[i]"You emit an dreadful aura, instilling fear into lesser beings... "[/i]

Some creatures will not attack you on sight, unless provoked.
However, some creatures will act more hostile towards you.
You move around faster to better hunt down your enemies.
The Darkness will not attack you.

[b][Death's Embrace][/b]

[i]"When your physical form is at risk, a part of you becomes ethereal, trapped between life and death... "[/i]

While at very low Health, your physical attacks deal no damage to enemies, 
however enemy attacks do very little damage to you.

[b][The Eternal Hunt][/b]

[i]"You may never rest, as Wolf's insatiable hunger fuels your desire to always hunt... "[/i]

You can't go to sleep at will.
You get hungry very often, as your Hunger is rapidly draining over time.
Eating food is less effective at restoring your Hunger.
Successfully hunting down and killing an enemy restores up to 10% of your Hunger.

Whenever your Hunger gets very low, you receive the [Wolf's Frenzy] effect, 
which will dramatically increase your Movement Speed, 
however your Sanity will be rapidly going down.

- Weakneses -

Despite being immune to the dark, she still has no vision at night.
While she can delay her death when dealing with lesser enemies, 
stronger one's can kill you without triggering [Death's Embrace] effect.
Have to feed the damn spirit dog all the time.

Hound's Tooth

Regular Trap

*Ecologist
Blood 150, Hunger 150, Sanity 300.

Initial Carry ① Ecological Wand ② Leaf Umbrella ③ Flow Form *1 ④ MiuMiu's Backpack ⑤ 5 Random Miu-Style Dishes

Abilities: 
Pure Water is Life: Muelsyse can use  Ecological Adaptation to create a Flow Form.

Open Water is Life: -25% of materials required to make all items.

MiuMiu loves shiny things, so you can craft rainbow gems!

Since Muelsyse is a water sprite, of course she can ignore all the negative effects of humidity; Flowform and Muelsyse can walk on water without drowning. Muelsyse can fall in the sea without negative effects.

Muelsyse is not a fire elf, therefore she fears scorching heat and takes double damage when overheated, but does not catch fire.

As Rhinelab's youngest ecological director, naturally, Muelsyse can grow crops with her empty hands. Same with Wormwood. Muelsyse can talk to plants on a large scale. Plants grow 50% faster in a minute after interacting with her. Plants also love the Muelsyse, so Muelsyse will not be harmed when picking plants (including cacti and roses).

Pets/Followers
1) Muelsyse's Toast Puppy: A cute dog that is the only one of its kind in the world, will only be born in Mandrake Plains during dusk, and can only be adopted by Muelsyse. The puppy comes with 4x4=16 storage compartments, and has a freshness function (same as the fridge, but can also store items other than food), and close enough to the puppy can restore 2.5 san per second. It's really cute and adorable, you guys should go and adopt it! Be nice to this lil cutie! Exclusive props include a cute little fried egg kennel, if you are not taking the puppy on the day of the expedition, please be sure to let the puppy stay in the kennel!

Note: Don't worry about the puppy getting harmed, nothing can hurt its health, it is invincible. 

Muelsyse's Slime: A magical slime that is the only one of its kind in the whole world, and is found in the Pig Village with its neighbour, Grom, and spawns slime that is used to make magical items!

Persimmon Tree: grows randomly in all corners of the Eternal Continent, you are welcome to use persimmons to make Muelsyse's exclusive cuisine~.

④ Flow form: consume 50 ecological adaptation to make, the production CD is 25s. Initially, it will appear as a water drop, and can only be included in the Miu Miu's item bar (backpack is not allowed), other characters cannot pick it up. Place it on the ground, and use the right click of any character to summon it into the form of a water body, which will replicate the character's blood and attack coefficients and mitigation multipliers at a rate of 0.9. If the character is wearing equipment, the form will copy the character's properties after being influenced by the equipment (so best to summon a flow form to replicate you after you are wearing an equipment). Each aqueous form lasts for a maximum of 24 minutes (Tactical Point status (the initial water drop that has not replicated) does not count as duration, and counts from the time it is summoned). It can attack empty-handed with an attack power of 34. It can be equipped with equipment for the head and hands as well as body parts. Up to five pieces of it can be present at the same time. 

Each attack by each Flowform can steal one point of Attack Power from the target of the attack (Steal: -1 for the opponent, +1 for the Flowform), up to a maximum of 25 points per enemy unit, with each Flowform increasing Attack Power by up to 25 points.

Note: items worn by flowforms will return to Muelsyse's bar box/ backpack once they disappear, make sure you have enough space (perhaps keep your stuff with the puppy?)
Note 2: the 

Eco-adaptation: can be a max of 100 points (appears at the top right corner of the screen, can change its location by right click)
①How to increase Eco-Adaptation: Planting seeds +1, Planting trees +1, Talking to 10 plants +1, when humidity exceeds 60, Eco-Adaptation goes up by 1 per second.
②Consumption: crafting flow shape-50, consume 5 points to bring the humidity of a plot back to full.

Props:
① Muelsyse's wand: attack power 34, attack distance 8, no durability. Left click to attack, and right click on a planted plot consumes 5 Ecological Adaptation to bring its moisture back to full. （Click X to retrieve wand, no matter where it is）
② Leaf Umbrella: 100% heat insulation, 100% waterproof. No durability. Cannot be crafted.
③ Mulesyse's Exclusive Backpack: Initially comes with a 16-compartment backpack with 30% Freshness preservation skill, and 5% movement speed bonus.
-The backpack can be insulated by giving it Deerclops' Eyeballs and Ice Cubes, and gradually become permanently insulated by the items given, up to a maximum of 1 Eyeball and 200 Ice Cubes.
-The backpack also gains protection from the cold, gradually reaching permanent insulation through items given, up to a maximum of one sunfish and 30 cowhairs. 
-If Muelsyse is injured, the backpack drains 10 satiety and returns 10 hp every 20s.


Skills (appears at the bottom left corner of the screen, can change its position by right click)
First icon: immediately summon a flow form using 50 Ecological Adaptation, CD 25s. It will last 24 minutes, maximum of 5 can co-exist.
① Progressive Rundown: immediately returns 30 Ecological Adaptation. cd 120s (2 minutes).

② Ecological Coupling: consumes 30 Ecological Adaptation to return 5% blood per second to all flow forms and increase damage reduction by 25% for 15s. cd 35s.

③ Shallow Non-Entropic Adaptation: consumes 50 Ecological Adaptation to restore 100% blood to all Fluxforms and refresh their existence. cd50s.

No skeleton is created upon death. Muelsyse in ghost state can be resurrected using any of the flow forms (any form). All flow forms disappear after resurrection.

publishedfiledetails.title: Koishi Komeiji
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]Koishi Komeiji, the youkai of the Subconscious from Touhou Project![/b][/h1]

Koishi was originally a satori who could read mind of others, but she was hurt by the fear and hatred towards her species. She tried to destroy her mind-reading ability by closing her Third Eye. She lost conscious mind in this process, but got the ability to manipulate subconscious. She could no longer be hated, but neither could she be loved, or even remembered by others. She is now a lovely but dreadful youkai motivated by her nature.

[h1][b]-Stats-[/b][/h1]
[b]Normal Mode[/b]
Health: 135
Hunger: 125
Sanity: 50

[b]Youkai Mode[/b]
Health: 270
Hunger: 150
Sanity: 50

[h1][b]-Perks-[/b][/h1]
[b][Unconscious][/b]
Koishi's sanity won't be affected by monsters or darkness.

[b][Subconscious][/b]
Koishi has 2 states - Id and Superego. She has different status in each state.
[h1]Id [/h1]
Faster walking speed, attacking speed, and starve rate, higher damage , and more vulnerable.
[h1]Superego [/h1]
Slower walking speed and starve rate, normal attacking speed, lower damage, and more damage resistance.

[b][Body of Youkai][/b]
Koishi will restore 0.5HP/s in Youkai Mode. The buffs in both states will be greater and the debuffs will be smaller.

[h1][b]-Mechanisms-[/b][/h1]
[b]Subconscious Mechanism[/b]
[i]-Koishi gains 0.5san/s in Superego and switches to Id when sanity > 48.
-Koishi loses 0.5san/s in Id and switches to Superego when sanity < 2.
-Koishi'll become invisible in Superego.Her enemies'll quickly forget about her.
-Koishi's Third Eye can switch the state of Koishi. The Eye has a cooldown of 10 seconds.
-Koishi's sanity won't be affected by food.[/i] 

[b]Pseudo-ego Mechanism[/b]
[i]-Koishi has another state: Pseudo-ego. She has very standard stats in this state. She will switch to Superego when sanity < 5, and to Id when sanity > 45.
-Koishi gains 0.2san/s in Superego and switches to Pseudo-ego when sanity > 15. 
-Koishi loses 0.2san/s in Id and switches to Pseudo-ego when sanity < 35.
-Koishi's Third Eye can turn on/off her invisibility. Koishi starves much faster than normal when becoming invisible.
-Koishi's sanity will be affected by food.[/i] 

[h1][b]-Spellcards-[/b][/h1]
[b]Dream Sign「Ancestors are Watching You」[/b] 
Use Koishi's power to make beings around fall asleep and experience nightmares. The non-player entities which can sleep will all fall asleep for 15 seconds, and will gradually experience non-reduceable health loss. If PVP is enabled, players will also fall asleep and lose 150 sanity. However, if they wake up halfway, they will not experience incoming health and sanity loss. This spellcard has 15s CD and can be used 3 times.

[b]「Philosophy of a Hated Person」[/b]
Project subconscious fear into Koishi's enemies and make them vulnerable. This forces the enemies to panic for 15 seconds. Meanwhile, they will experience more damage when attacked. The enemies which won't panic will take a larger vulnerability. This spellcard has 15s CD and can be used 2 times.

[b]「Subterranean Rose」[/b]
Project Koishi's inner heart to the reality, creating a brambly rose garden around her. This will do huge amounts of damage to enemies around. Bosses in the range will experience an extra health loss. This spellcard has 120s CD and can be used 1 time.

[b]「Stinging Mind」[/b]
Koishi summons rose mines around her, but then forgets about them immediately. The mines will become less visible after 3s. Any monster stepping on an mine can activate it, causing an explosion that does 50 (100 in Youkai mode) damage per rose to creatures in the range. Players can also activate mines in PVP mode. This spellcard can be used 2 times.

[b]Response「Youkai Polygraph」[/b]
Detect any fluctuation in creatures' mind to destinguish them. Spawn several rose bands around Koishi. Every rose will deal 10 damage/s to monster around (20 in Youkai Mode), and heal 2 HP/s for alliances. This spellcard cannot be casted again when working, and can be used 1 time.

[b]Memory「DNA's Flaw」[/b]
Carve the power of subconsiousness into Koishi's actions. Each casting can increase 2% moving speed & damage absorption, and 3% damage bonus.This can be done for 10 times. This spellcard can be used 1 time.

[b]Heart Sign「Selfless Love」[/b]
Koishi inverts the subconsciousness in her actions. Turning her to Id setting sanity to 50 if in Superego, and to Superego setting sanity to 0 if in Id.
If Koishi's in Pseudo-ego, she will switch to Id when san > 25. Otherwise she will switch to Superego. This spellcard can be used 4 times.

[b]Instinct「Freudian」[/b]
Koishi releases the power of subconsciousness state, upgrading her ability for 30 seconds.
[h1]Id[/h1]
Release an impact wave, harm enemies around and push them back, and stun them for 4 seconds. Koishi's damage bonus and attacking speed'll increase, but suffers extra damage.
When it ends, summon the wave, harming enemies around and pulling them to Koishi.
[h1]Superego[/h1]
Summon an attraction wave, harm enemies around and pull them towards Koishi, and force them to attack Koishi. Koishi'll become invincible, but her damage bonus and attacking speed will decrease.
When it ends, release the wave, harming enemies around and pushing them back.
[h1]Pseudo-ego[/h1]
Summon a shock wave, harm enemies around. Koishi'll have higher damage bonus, attacking speed and damage absorption.
When it ends, summon a shock wave, harm enemies around.

[h1][b]-Items-[/b][/h1]
[b]Koishi's Hat[/b]: Koishi's favourite hat, seemingly made of something really hard. It can provide 30% (60% in Youkai Mode) damage absorption and is quite waterproof and insulating. It has very high duration. You can also use flints and rocks to fix it. Can be upgraded at Ancient Altar.

[b]Koishi's Knife[/b]: A fruit knife that's even bigger than a butcher's knife. It does 40 (65 in Youkai Mode) damage. Koishi can activate her occultism "Mary's Phone" by rightclicking the knife when equiped. This will allow her to strike further, and teleport to the target's back, doubling the damage. This attack will consume 20 hunger (10 in Youkai Mode). Can be upgraded at Ancient Altar.

[b]Koishi's Third Eye[/b]: Koishi's noumenon, but somehow becomes detachable after coming to this world. When Koishi's attacked while equiping it, the tentacles will strike back immediately, dealing 40 (80 in Youkai Mode) damage to the attacker, and it can be used by rightclicking. Its use in each mechanism is listed above. Can be upgraded at Ancient Altar.

[b]Blue Rose[/b]: A beautiful but delicate flower that shouldn't exist in this world.
When Koishi kills any non-machine entity, it has a small chance to flourish the soil and grow a blue rose nearby. When Koishi kills an epic enemy, its blood will grow 3 blue roses. She will also spawn blue roses periodically when it's fullmoon.
It can be picked, but any picker except Koishi will lose health and sanity. The flower can be eaten to restore 2 health and 2 hunger. It can also be used as ingredients for spellcards of Koishi.

[b]Decorative Roses[/b]: These can be decorate your home. They also emit light like fireflies. Decorative roses have different colours and can be crafted by Koishi using a blue rose and a firefly.

----------
[h1][b]Configuration:[/b][/h1]
-Language: switch between English and Chinese
-Mode: switch between Normal Mode and Youkai Mode. Koishi's status will become imba in Youkai Mode
-Night vision: switch ON/OFF night vision
-Character Mechanism: switch between Subconscious and Ego Mechanism.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]HololiveEN: Calliope Mori[/h1]
	
	
[h1]What is this mod?[/h1]
	It adds HololiveEN Vtuber, Calliope Mori in DST.
	
	[img] https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1652224137648760981/761C2CEC1FCD68573405D137871D625565943A8A/ [/img]

[h1]Default Stats[/h1]

[img] https://imgur.com/MO5u0gY.png [/img]

[b]There is a huge config file enjoy it how you like it![/b]

[h1]Immortality[/h1]

	She is a Reaper, Death can't die... but can fall a sleep? 
	(She can die if you change the settings in the config for more challenge.)
	
	Reaching 10% bellow on health or sanity will cause her to fall a sleep for 30 seconds by default.

	"Sleeping is like death". Falling a sleep because of this threshold will reduce your max health and might get you stuck sleeping forever if you've reach the lowest health reduction. You might need someone else to save you when this happens.

	This also causes her to recover health and sanity during the process.
	(Even when she is not immortal)

	[b][Sleepy Reaper][/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/wwuQZHU.gif [/img]
	
	
[h1]Items[/h1]

	[b] The Reaper's Scythe [/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/tNavPiw.png [/img]

	[b]Recipe[/b]
    Multiple version that can be chosen in the config
[list]

    [*]Cheap
	[img] https://imgur.com/f45QiCc.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/eytAFel.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/aMOj7kP.png [/img] x 6

	[*]Normal (The default recipe)
	[img] https://imgur.com/f45QiCc.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/zS5LX1c.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/aMOj7kP.png [/img] x 6
	
	[*]Expensive
	[img] https://imgur.com/f45QiCc.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/BR7QkrH.png [/img] x 6 [img] https://imgur.com/QcS2yXH.png [/img] x 6

[/list]

(Almost everything is editable in the config)
[b][Strengths][/b]

Soul UI
[img]https://imgur.com/Whzypdj.png[/img]
Calli can reap souls to increase the crit rate of the Scythe. 
By default you need 60 souls to get 70% crit rate(The default max value). 
Base damage is as strong as a Dark sword with no side effect to Calli.
Slightly longer range compare to other weapons.
Deals a lot of damage on crit (300% by default).
Killing heals Calli based on the max health of her victim. By default it's 5% of their max health.
Killing Ghost gives 10 Souls worth and Bosses give 30 Souls while other mobs only gives 1.

[b][100% Crit rate example][/b]
[img] https://imgur.com/31CHxEP.png [/img]


She can use Soul Strike, A single target blink strike that deals 100% Crit when aimed directly at a target.
It uses 5% of your souls based on your max soul capacity and uses 1 durability.
It can be aimed on the floor for mobility, but cost of using will be the same as attacking.

[b][Soul Strike][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/wZucxPk.png[/img]


[b][Weakness][/b]
Collecting souls will take time and the crit rate starts at 0%.
You will lose souls when you partially die aka sleep.
You also lose souls when you get hurt.
It will break eventually, but the souls are kept by Calli so any scythe will work.
Somewhat pricey to replace.
Others can use it, but it only acts like a normal dark sword including negative sanity debuff.

	[b] Underworld wine [/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/Rlv55CM.png [/img]
	Knocks you out in 1 shot. 
	It restores sanity, but consumes [b]hunger[/b] and [b]sanity[/b] and makes the consumer fall a sleep.
	It restores more sanity than it consumes, but be careful because it might make your sanity go less than 10%.
	(You won't lose your souls here, unless your sanity went less than 10% of your max sanity because of this.)

	[b]Recipe[/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/f45QiCc.png [/img] x 1 [img] https://imgur.com/HMGCwVy.png [/img] x 3

	[b] Wine Guzzler Hat [/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/841sJdw.png [/img]
	This blursed item is a gift from Ina. It restores sanity and consumes hunger over time. 
	It also acts like an eyebrella/umbrella.
	It can be repaired just like other hats in the game.

	[b]Recipe[/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/Rlv55CM.png [/img] x 4 [img] https://imgur.com/uwrIBz7.png [/img] x 1

[b][Wine Guzzler Hat preview][/b]
[img] https://imgur.com/Bmja8qo.png [/img]

[b] Kazoo [/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/TJX3tB6.png[/img]
Calli's Kazoo is a cursed item use for summoning evil spirits(Ghosts/Nightmares).
The spirits only spawns at graves. 
If the user has above 50% sanity it will spawn ghosts, but if she has 50% or less it will summon nightmare creatures instead.
There's no limit on how many graves it can affect only it's range has a limit and durability.
It only works during the [b]NIGHT[/b].

[b]Recipe[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/nh8aVzg.png[/img] x 4 [img]https://imgur.com/f45QiCc.png[/img] x 4

Special thanks to Dominik K for providing the kazoo sounds!


[h1]Cursed Night[/h1]
	She is considered a monster and emits a negative sanity aura.
	This will make pigmans and bunnyman attack you so beware.

[h1]Graveyard[/h1]
	Staying near a graves gives her sanity regeneration.
	Each grave sanity regeneration is stack able.
        Player's ghost gives Calli sanity boost instead of decreasing it.

Up to a maximum of some number (4 default)

The Corrupt Flower Box
Uses Alchemy Engine to prototype
Requires 2 boards, 4 manure, and 6 evil petals
Periodically grows evil flowers around it (2/day default)
Up to a maximum of some number (4 default)

The Foliage Planter Box
Uses Shadow Manipulator to prototype
Requires 2 boards, 4 manure, and 6 foliage
Periodically grows cave ferns around it (2/day default)
Up to a maximum of some number (4 default)

这个MOD跟原版千年狐有较大的区别，下面是简介：

[h1]狐狸专属物品：在制作栏(冒险家物品)里制作.[/h1]
[h1]狐狸商店：左下角购物车图标.[/h1]
打开商店后点右上角的“+”图标召唤狐狸充值员充值。
商店可以在MOD设置中打开或关闭。

[h1]【左上角头像UI】[/h1]
1、点击头像可以切换形态，不能手动切换白狐狸，死亡狐狸形态。
2、狐狸死亡后可以点击头像下方的复活按钮复活，需要100鬼魂能量值，鬼魂能量值会随时间恢复。

[h1]【左下小头像UI】[/h1]
按【Ctrl+鼠标左键】拖动
屏幕左边有个狐狸图标，点它。
等级旁边有个箭头，经验满足升级所需后点它可以升级人物。

[h1]升级[/h1]
吃东西、打怪会获得经验，你最多可以存储5个等级的经验值。

[h1]红狐狸[/h1]
靠近火堆回san值，（专属技能：火焰盛焰），只有装备芭蕉扇时才能使用。
技能可以在UI面板中点击技能图标启用或禁用，不影响开启技能状态。
开启火焰盛焰状态时：体温会渐渐提升、能力值提升、会消耗火元素。
不惧怕高温。能力会随早中晚、天气温度变化（气温越高能力值越高）。
拥有小范围夜视能力，饥饿值低到一定程度时将失去夜视能力。
[h1]冰狐狸[/h1]
靠近火堆掉san值，靠近冰火堆回san值。（专属技能：冰域）.在冰域中的怪物（除BOSS外）将会被减速。
技能可以在UI面板中点击技能图标启用或禁用，不影响开启技能状态。
开启冰域技能状态时能力提升，脚下会出现冰圈，冰圈会发少量的光，一段时间后冰圈消失，会消耗冰元素。
不惧怕低温，比一般人物更怕高温。
能力值随天气温度变化（气温越低能力值越高）。
[h1]月狐狸[/h1]
无专属技能，更强的能力，会缓慢回血，免疫冰冻、火烧、睡眠、虚弱等效果，攻击时有几率触发闪电攻击，只吃肉类。
[h1]白狐狸[/h1]
精神值低的时候，只吃肉。
攻击力会随san值变化。

[h1]跳跃[/h1]
默认《跳跃》键【G】,（更改按键请到游戏内设置）
跳跃时有短暂的无敌时间，在一定时间内再次跳跃可施展连跳效果，可在水上跳跃，并且会自动拾取小范围内的物品。

默认《技能》键【R】,（更改按键请到游戏内设置）
默认《小狐狸控制》键【X】,（更改按键请到游戏内设置）
鼠标移动到墙壁或者矿石上时，当显示跳跃时，点鼠标右键即可跳过去。(此功可以在设置中关闭)

[h1]【小狐狸】[/h1]
理论上小狐狸可以穿戴所有装备。
小狐狸可以升级、打怪等.（吃灵魂结晶、兔兔包升级）。
攻击时有几率触发·火焰盛焰·技能（受等级影响），需要装备芭蕉扇。
制造数量随人物等级提高。
受到来自主人的攻击时会变成“挨打的小狐狸球”，跟用狐狸水晶球打包起来一样的效果，但是会受到一定伤害。

[h1]【小龙】[/h1]
初始自带龙蛋，放物品栏自动孵化。
打怪，吃东西可获得经验值。
吃灵魂结晶、兔兔包获得大量经验。

[h1]【狐狸箱】[/h1]
可以存放物品，有较弱的保鲜能力。
月圆放满兔兔包（每个格子放一个即可）可以升级狐狸箱（容量增加，有较强的保鲜能力）.

[h1]装备：【芭蕉扇】【狐狸裙子】【狐狸面具】【狐狸面具(白)】[/h1]
可以强化升级【鼠标拿起强化石移动到装备上点右键】
穿上时耐久会渐渐减少(武器除外)，耐久度消耗完后不会消失，但会失去所有性能。
耐久度可以使用“能源石”修复。

[h1]【芭蕉扇】[/h1]
拥有【砍树、挖矿、铲子】功能，铲子功能默认关闭，可在MOD设置里自行开启。

[h1]【狐狸裙子】[/h1]
强化+11时可使用背包空间功能，若没耐久时将不能使用背包空间，里面的东西不会掉出。

[h1]【狐狸面具】[/h1]
强化等级达到满级时可以使用进化石进化成【狐狸面具(白)】，等级越高进化时新面具继承的属性越高。
右键面具变成房子的时候防水100%，100%减伤。

[h1]【狐狸面具(白)】[/h1]
强化只有防御力与耐久会增长
旧狐狸面具进化获得（继承自己不能成长的属性部分）
右键面具变成房子的时候防御、防水100%

[h1]建筑：【房子】【亭子】【冷冻罐子】【红焰营火】【冰焰营火】[/h1]
不会被BOSS一下秒掉。
可以使用“能源石”修理。
建筑在被破坏时会有公告提示。

[h1]【房子】[/h1]
可以存放物品【112格】，有【能源】时将拥有强大的保鲜能力。
鼠标右键打开房子仓库，或者鼠标点起一个物品直接点房子
灯光功能：夜晚自动开启，需要【能源】
充能：需要【能源石】，拿起能源石对着房子，按【左Ctrl + 鼠标右键】即可充能。
有【能源】的时候即使在【白天】也能睡觉。

[h1]【狐狸墙】[/h1]
高耐久，会自动回复血量

[h1]【冷冻罐子】[/h1]
有冰块能量才能维持永久保鲜功能。
冰块能量存储系统：冰块能量会慢慢消耗，可存可取。
存：拿着冰块右键点罐子存冰。
取：直接右键点击罐子可取出冰块。

[h1]【狐狸水晶球】[/h1]
可以把小狐狸装起来放身上包里，方便携带，需要时像种植一样种出来即可。

[h1]【灵魂结晶】[/h1]
打怪掉落，制作小狐狸的必需材料之一。
给小狐狸吃可以回满她的血量并且升一级。

[h1]【兔兔包】[/h1]
吃了之后回三围。
大狐狸角色吃了有回复加成。
给小狐狸吃可以回满她的血量并且升一级。

[h1]宝石类[/h1]：打怪或挖矿获得。
【水晶石】--合成强化石、进化石、幸运石、保级石等物品的材料
【强化石】--制作栏合成、打怪、挖矿获得，装备强化+9后使用将降低成功概率
【高级强化石】--装备强化+9前使用100%成功
【合成石】--合成各种物品所需材料
【进化石】--装备进化必需品
【幸运石】--增加强化成功几率，放物品栏或背包即可。
【保级石】--已弃用。

[h1]【能源石】[h1]
可以修理大狐狸装备、建筑、墙、给房子充【能源】，也可以当作燃料给火堆用。

publishedfiledetails.title: Gorge Crops!
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod adds the crops from the Gorge into the regular game!

All craftables are in the farm tab.

[h1][b]*New*[/b][/h1]

Regular crops now farmable on the soil but they will grow at the basic farm rate not at the improved farm rate. Made the mealingstone keep its products and have a fail recipe if you don't use 3 or more turnips or wheat (can't use 2 of each or you'll get ash).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Vegetable Garden:[/b]

The crops can only be grown on the vegetable garden which provides 9 spots to till. Each patch of soil has 5 cycles of use before it needs fertiliser. Inspect the soil to find out if it needs fertiliser. [i]You can change the number of cycles or turn it off in the configuration screen.[/i]

[b]Hoe:[/b]

You need to use a hoe to till the soil. It has 30 uses and does as much damage as an axe.

[b]Seed Packets:[/b]

The seed packets can be made but they don't always drop new seeds so good luck! Birds will, of course, help you get more seeds of a specific crop. Seeds can be found in tumbleweeds and you can turn off the recipe or change its difficulty.

[b]Crops:[/b]  All the crops are considered 1 veggie when used in the crock pot except for wheat which is not edible. [i]Carrots are not included 'cause I said so. You may change the number of crops harvested in the configuration menu.[/i]

Crops vary in growth time and healing values. [i] [Growth rate can be configured] [/i]

You also cannot leave the crops planted too long or they will die on the vine.
[i][You can turn this off or change the times in the configuration menu] [/i]

Each grow time is in hours of sunlight like regular crops so it takes that much time of day or dusk but not night.

[u]Tomatoes, Turnips and Potatoes[/u]: Take the longest to grow - Base rate is 1.5 days

[u]Onion and Garlic[/u]: In between - Base rate is 1.25 days

[u]Wheat[/u]: Quickest - Base rate is 1 day

[b]Mealingstone:[/b] Just there to grind wheat into flour and turnips into sugar. Flour is considered 1 flour (no longer a veggie) and turnip sugar is worth 1 sweetener (can usually be used instead of honey).

[b]New Recipes:[/b] 

[u]Bread[/u]: 3 flour + veg/fruit/ice filler
[u]Candied Potato[/u]: 2 potatoes (any) + turnip sugar + veg/fruit/ice filler
[u]Meat Cake[/u]: 1 meat + turnip sugar + flour + meat/veg/fruit/ice filler
[u]Pomegranate Puff[/u]: pomegranate (any) + turnip sugar + flour + ice
[u]Stew[/u]: potato (any) + 0.5 meat + onion/garlic (any) + 0.5 veg
[u]Tomato Bisque[/u]: 2 tomatoes (any) + onion/garlic (any) + fish/eel
[u]Turnips Soup[/u]: 2 turnips (any) + onion/garlic (any) + veg/fruit/ice filler

[b]Mushroom Stumps and Forest Mushrooms:[/b]

Mushroom stumps will now appear in any new world you make. The mushrooms count as 0.5 veggies.


[b]Optionally Modified Old Recipes:[/b] 

I have made an option to modify some of the old food recipes to include the new crops. This does make them a bit harder so, by default, the changed recipes are [b]OFF[/b] unless you configure them to be on.

Frog Bunwich, Buttermuffin, Pumpkin Cookies, Fish Sticks, Honey Nuggets, Perogies, Waffles and Dragon Pie will need [b]flour[/b]. I also made dragon pie no longer take twigs too just to be difficult.

Meaty Stew will need a [b]potato (any)[/b].

Meatballs will need a [b]tomato (any) and onion/garlic (any).[/b]

Ratatouille will need a [b]tomato (any).[/b]

Fish Tacos and Guacamole will need [b]onion/garlic (any).[/b]


As always, please enjoy and let me know if there are any issues.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A side note, I won't be porting over the recipes from the Gorge (I don't think Klei want the recipes modded at all).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
